scoring_justification: The main artifacts are computed ΔG, D_Hf, and μ¹⁸²W tables. Full recompute from raw DFT/molecular dynamics logs is infeasible in the verifier sandbox, so result-level comparison against paper-reported gold with tolerant thresholds and structural consistency checks is used.

hidden_assets.purpose: reference values for D_Hf (from paper Table 1) and μ¹⁸²W evolution (from paper Fig. 5a via solve.sh model)
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper Table 1 (log10 D_Hf) and paper Figure 5a description (peak solid +18, liquid -14, exponential decay)
hidden_assets.generation_method: log10 values extracted verbatim from Table 1; μ¹⁸²W timeseries generated from the reference model described in the paper (peak solid 18, linear ramp to 50 Myr, exponential decay with 390 Myr timescale, liquid constant -14) matching the curves in Fig. 5a
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These numbers are the paper's own reported results; they are used as hidden gold to compare against the agent's reproduction.

outputs.description: Difference in defect formation energies between Hf on Mg site and Si site in bridgmanite at 2000 K.
Hf partition coefficient between bridgmanite and silicate melt at multiple P,T conditions.
Tungsten isotopic anomaly evolution for solid and liquid reservoirs.

output_contract.notes: Hidden scoring will compare submitted values to paper-reported references with tolerances (e.g., ±0.2 eV for ΔG, factor-of-2 for D_Hf, 30% relative for μ¹⁸²W) and also check internal consistency (e.g., D_Hf increases with pressure).

steps.description: Check sign, pressure trend, and concentration ordering of ΔG.

structural_checks.sign: For 283_ppb, delta_G_eV must be negative at pressures >= 40 GPa (paper states ΔG becomes negative above ~20 GPa).
structural_checks.monotonicity: For each concentration, delta_G_eV must decrease monotonically with increasing pressure.
structural_checks.concentration_ordering: At each pressure, delta_G_eV for 732_ppm must be <= that for 283_ppb (more negative).

steps.description: Compare D_Hf values to paper Table 1 log10 gold, and check monotonic pressure trend.
steps.trend_checks: D_Hf must increase with pressure at each fixed temperature (3000, 4000, 5000 K).

steps.description: Compare μ182W evolution to paper model (peak solid +18, liquid -14, exponential decay).
